<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import { variants } from "../utils";

  /** NavItem: the classes of each value (shadcn/cva style). */
  export const navItemVariants = variants({
    base: "flex w-full items-center p-2 rounded",
    variants: {
      level: {
        "1": "",
        "2": "",
        "3": "pr-2 pl-12",
        "4": "pr-2 pl-20",
      },
      state: {
        default: "",
        selected: "",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: { level: "1", state: "default" },
  });
  /** NavItem: the classes of each value (shadcn/cva style). */
  export const navItemContentVariants = variants({
    base:
      "flex h-8 min-w-0 flex-1 items-center justify-between px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground " +
      "inset-ring inset-ring-transparent rounded",
    variants: {
      level: {
        "1": "",
        "2": "",
        "3": "px-2",
        "4": "px-2",
      },
      state: {
        default: "",
        selected: "bg-background text-foreground inset-ring-border",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: { level: "1", state: "default" },
  });

  export type NavItemProps = {
    selected?: boolean;
    level?: "1" | "2" | "3" | "4";
    href?: string;
    interactive?: boolean;
    reserveRight?: boolean;
    contentClass?: string;
    class?: string;
    children?: Snippet;
    icon?: Snippet;
    right?: Snippet;
    onclick?: () => void;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import ButtonPlain from "../primitives/button-plain/button-plain.svelte";
  import LinkPlain from "../primitives/link-plain/link-plain.svelte";
  import NavItemRow from "../components/nav-item-row.svelte";
  import { cn } from "../utils";

  let {
    selected = false,
    level,
    href,
    interactive = false,
    reserveRight = false,
    contentClass,
    class: className,
    children,
    icon,
    right,
    onclick,
  }: NavItemProps = $props();
  const state = $derived(selected ? "selected" : "default");
  const outer = $derived(
    cn(
      navItemVariants({ level: level, state: state }),
      "group in-data-[nav=collapsed]:justify-center",
      className,
    )
  );
  const inner = $derived(
    cn(
      navItemContentVariants({ level: level, state: state }),
      (!selected && "group-hover:bg-muted"),
      "in-data-[nav=collapsed]:w-10 in-data-[nav=collapsed]:flex-none in-data-[nav=collapsed]:justify-center in-data-[nav=collapsed]:px-0",
      contentClass,
    )
  );
</script>

{#if href}
  <LinkPlain
    href={href}
    class={outer}
    aria-current={(selected ? "page" : undefined)}
    data-slot="nav-item"
    data-state={state}
    onclick={() => onclick?.()}
  >
    <NavItemRow inner={inner} reserveRight={reserveRight} icon={icon} right={right} children={children} />
  </LinkPlain>
{:else if interactive}
  <ButtonPlain
    type="button"
    class={cn(outer, "text-left")}
    aria-current={(selected ? "page" : undefined)}
    data-slot="nav-item"
    data-state={state}
    onclick={() => onclick?.()}
  >
    <NavItemRow inner={inner} reserveRight={reserveRight} icon={icon} right={right} children={children} />
  </ButtonPlain>
{:else}
  <Box class={outer} aria-current={(selected ? "page" : undefined)} data-slot="nav-item" data-state={state}>
    <NavItemRow inner={inner} reserveRight={reserveRight} icon={icon} right={right} children={children} />
  </Box>
{/if}
